title: Penpot: direct manipulation with edit ownership
summary: Coordinate a finite canvas, layer identity, exact properties and recoverable edits without redirecting history to the current selection.
use_when: A bounded creative workspace needs pointer placement, an equivalent keyboard path and undo that retains edited-object ownership.
avoid_when: A complete vector editor, multiplayer conflict resolution, persistent file versions or canvas-only access is required.
